title: Bind publication to prepared receipts and report actual storage effects
statement: The Work record storage Module shall supply exact candidate and observed-state facts for receipt preparation, publish only with applicable prepublication readiness for those facts, and return the actual known storage outcome without allowing reporting limitations to misrepresent commitment.

what.problem: A command renderer cannot guarantee truthful bounded output if persistence publishes a different candidate or hides the resulting transaction state.
what.desired_outcome: The prepared public receipt and actual storage operation refer to the same subject, and the command receives reliable facts for saved, unchanged, conflict, interruption, or recovery outcomes.

why.rationale: SR-046 receipt safety requires cooperation at the mutation boundary while keeping output-contract ownership in MOD-010 and byte/commitment ownership in MOD-011.

stakeholders: Command adapters preparing safe storage receipts
Actors relying on truthful transaction outcomes

conditions: Candidate preparation supplies facts to the command Module.
An admitted publication crosses the authoritative mutation boundary.
Publication or explicit recovery establishes a terminal result or leaves interrupted or indeterminate effects.

contexts: IF-003 candidate preparation and publication interaction with MOD-010.
Actual storage and recovery outcomes for the selected operational-record transaction.

how.approach: Expose exact candidate identity/revision, changed-target and attributable observation facts before publication; verify their correspondence to command-side receipt readiness without owning its renderer. Preserve known committed, unchanged, failed, and recovery-required state in the resulting storage facts.

how_much.scope: MOD-011 supplies storage and observed-basis facts and enforces the prepublication condition; MOD-010 retains FUNC-048 and the public output limits/serialization. No extra rendering Function, mandatory callback, new public protocol, or inferred approval is introduced.

acceptance_criteria: For new publication, start afresh under supported-writer exclusion, reread and check the current state, and reconstruct targeted edits or admit advanced supplied bytes through the common complete-candidate validation boundary. Supply the resulting exact candidate, changed targets, available state identities, and attributable observations for MOD-010 receipt preparation before mutation; outside-guard preparation or preview is not this publication basis. For explicit recovery, verify and use the exact retained before/candidate bytes for the selected action and supply those exact outcome facts without reconstructing or replaying semantic edits. In both cases, preserve candidate/current scope and unavailable-versus-established identity distinctions.

Observation facts identify the actual source-defined observed subject basis and diagnostics of the selected scan. They do not substitute historical expected subject hashes, a partial request read set, or observations reconstructed from a different selected state; unavailable or unsafe basis remains explicit.

Before authoritative publication, ensure the mandatory receipt readiness applies to the exact operation, candidate, format, and required facts supplied for that attempt. A changed candidate or stale basis cannot reuse earlier readiness; known nonmatching or unavailable readiness stops before publication while preserving the source guarantee that diagnostic volume alone cannot make an admissible correction unrecordable.

Return saved only for the actual durably committed candidate, unchanged only after its current preconditions pass, and conflict, busy, failed, or recovery-required when those are the actual known outcomes. Supply available identities and transaction context without inventing a coherent snapshot or presenting a partially published changed list as a saved result.

Postcommit optional-detail, renderer, or output-delivery failure cannot change the storage disposition into rejected or authorize rollback of acknowledged success. Preserve exact recovery and lost-response facts for explicit caller reconciliation; do not rerun a semantic update to manufacture a cleaner receipt.

sources.basis: Derived from SR-046 for the proposed MOD-011 responsibility. Allocates the persistence contribution to SR-046 criteria 1, 3, and 4. AR-025 remains the sole public receipt preparation owner; AR-021 and AR-022 establish the underlying committed and recovered facts consumed here. These criteria specify intended observations, not executed product evidence or an adoption of the REM authoring format by the CLI.
